sentences.pinyin: Jīng zūn de zhuānpīng lǐ cǎn:
sentences.usage: Formal greeting at the start of a cover letter.

sentences.chinese: 感谢您在百忙中阅读我的求职信。
sentences.pinyin: Gǎnxiè nín zài bǎimáng zhōng yuèdú wǒ de qiūzhí xìn.
sentences.translation: Thank you for reading my job application letter amidst your busy schedule.

sentences.chinese: 我对贵公司的[职位名称]一职非常感兴趣。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ duì guì gōngsī de [zhíwèi míngchēng] yīzhí fēicháng gǎn xìngqù.
sentences.translation: I am very interested in the [position name] role at your company.
sentences.usage: Expressing interest in a specific position.

sentences.chinese: 我拥有[相关技能或经验]，能够为贵公司带来[具体贡献]。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yōngyǒu [xiāngguān jìnéng huò jīngyàn], nénggòu wèi guì gōngsī dàilái [jùtǐ gòngxiàn].
sentences.translation: I possess [relevant skills or experience], which can bring [specific contributions] to your company.

sentences.chinese: 我毕业于[大学名称]，主修[专业名称]。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bì yè yú [dàxué míngchēng], zhǔxiū [zhuānyè míngchēng].
sentences.translation: I graduated from [university name], majoring in [major name].

sentences.chinese: 在[公司名称]工作期间，我负责[具体职责]。
sentences.pinyin: Zài [gōngsī míngchēng] gōngzuò qījiān, wǒ fùzé [jùtǐ zérèn].
sentences.translation: During my time at [company name], I was responsible for [specific duties].

sentences.chinese: 我擅长[具体技能]，并具备[资格证书]。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shàncháng [jùtǐ jìnéng], bìng jùbǐ [zīgé zhèngshū].
sentences.translation: I am skilled in [specific skills] and hold [qualifications/certifications].

sentences.chinese: 我具备出色的团队合作能力。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jùbǐ chūsè de tuánduì hézuò nénglì.

sentences.chinese: 我能够快速适应新环境并解决问题。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ nénggòu kuàisù shìyìng xīn huánjìng bìng jiějué wèntí.
sentences.translation: I can quickly adapt to new environments and solve problems.
